Tarikh | Episode 1047 | 22 August 2025
# Velvalee Dickinson, a doll shop owner in 1940s NYC, was arrested for WWII espionage.
# FBI suspected her coded letters, using doll terms to relay US Navy secrets.
# Despite strong suspicion, Dickinson was only convicted of censorship violations due to lack of direct proof of espionage.
# Released on parole in 1951, she lived under a new name; the exact date of her death remains debated.
